unit.why: A single anecdote about the Besht, who on his way to Chmielnik heard a heavenly proclamation that R. Yosef the teacher would die and refused to heal him; the man recovered through a doctor but then died from the doctor's ointment.

stories.start_quote: שוב שמעתי ממנו פ״א בדרך נסיעתו
stories.summary_en: The Besht hears a heavenly proclamation that R. Yosef the teacher of Chmielnik will die and refuses payment to heal him; a doctor cures him, but an ointment the doctor gives him against head lice kills him, and the Besht then explains his refusal.

tags.why: The plot is the fulfilment of the decree the Besht heard, despite the apparent recovery.

tags.why: The townspeople request healing, the Besht refuses, and a doctor heals the man.

tags.why: The Besht's reason for refusing becomes clear only after the death.
The tale is framed as heard orally from an informant.
